title: Personalized Projected Ascent for Federated Stackelberg Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.21295v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated minimax problems, such as distributionally robust optimization and adversarial training, include an inner maximization variable built from each client's local data. These variables differ in meaning and dimension from one client to the next, so averaging them across clients, as standard federated minimax methods do, is ill-posed. We therefore study a federated minimax problem where the minimization variable $\mathbf{x}$ is shared and aggregated, while each client retains the maximization variable $\mathbf{y}_i$ (personalized). Because these applications constrain $\mathbf{y}_i$ to a compact convex set, we analyze projected ascent directly. We show that, in the nonconvex-concave regime, this projected personalized scheme attains the standard sublinear rate. translated_title: 面向联邦Stackelberg优化的个性化投影上升方法
translated_abstract: 联邦极小极大问题（如分布式鲁棒优化和对抗训练）包含一个由各客户端本地数据构建的内层最大化变量。这些变量在不同客户端之间的含义和维度各不相同，因此像标准联邦极小极大方法那样在客户端间对它们取平均是不适定的。为此，我们研究了一类联邦极小极大问题：极小化变量 x 在客户端间共享并被聚合，而每个客户端保留各自的最大化变量 y_i（个性化）。由于这些应用将 y_i 约束在紧致凸集上，我们直接对投影上升方法进行分析。我们证明，在非凸-凹情形下，这种投影式个性化方案能够达到标准的次线性收敛速率；然而，在非凸-PL（Polyak-Łojasiewicz）情形下，由于 y_i 的随机更新，该方法会遇到一个与步长无关的噪声下限。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了VR-SGDA，其中引入了……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在联邦Stackelberg优化中让最大化变量保持客户端个性化并采用投影上升，证明了非凸-凹情形下达到标准次线性收敛速率，并针对非凸-PL情形中随机更新导致的与步长无关的噪声下限，提出方差缩减方法VR-SGDA加以缓解。
en_tdlr: Proposes personalized projected ascent for federated Stackelberg (minimax) optimization, proving standard sublinear convergence in the nonconvex-concave regime and introducing the variance-reduced VR-SGDA to overcome the stepsize-invariant noise floor arising from stochastic updates in the nonconvex-PL regime.
